+# Copyright: (c) 2026, Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocCLITtyIfy(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_links_references_and_rule(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(Ansible, https://example.org) R(guide, docs) HORIZONTALLINE'),
+                         'Ansible <https://example.org> guide \n-------------\n')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(site,https://example.org) R(topic,ref)'),
+                         'site <https://example.org> topic')
+
+    def test_multiple_macros_and_plain_text(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('Use M(copy) with B(bold), I(italic), C(value), U(url), and R(topic,ref).'),
+                         "Use [copy] with *bold*, `italic', `value', url, and topic.")
+
+    def test_parenthesized_words_and_unsupported_macros(self):
+        text = 'IBM(International Business Machines) and X(plain) with L(no comma)'
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), text)
